species.identity.meaning: Base section m is a symbol identity; form section ev requires registered base Species and strictly positive form. Registered base species=id/form0; forms use composed key. Lookup get_species_form tests composed identity then base and may return nil. Pokemon stores base species separately from form; species assignment uses DefaultForm_N then a positive incoming form, otherwise keeps prior form, clears ability cache and recalculates. Dynamic form, forced form and simple stored form have different read/write effects.
actual_consumers: SpeciesFiles individual versus explicit species image routes

species.text.meaning: Name/Category use s text, FormName/Pokedex q text. Pokemon nickname is separate; unnamed individual reads species name. Form label can be nil. Stats UI is a display consumer, not a second formula.
